audit.title: Imperial Church order 26 Constantinople mechanical map/objective audit
filesRead: docs/design/odysseys/imperial-church.json (episodes order 26 and matching episodeBlueprints entry)
audit.scope: Mechanical requirements, object/zone geometry, budget arithmetic, frame bounds, and geometric proximity to modern water controls displayed in the SVG. No historical, terrain, native-navigation, or gameplay approval.
method: Applied tools/design/geography.py tile_point to each stored hub coordinate using the stated WGS84 bbox and map size 400.
Checked tile-to-SVG mapping with renderer factor 650/(400-1), origin (55,85), SVG frame, and 0..399 tile bounds.

Transformed all six visible blue geographic-control line segments from SVG pixels back into tile coordinates; measured point/segment and route-segment/segment distances, and subtracted declared zone radii or corridor half-widths where relevant.

Compared objective requirement IDs, helper-to-court destination map, note-to-court map, resource transaction allocations, survival groups, optional subworld positions, difficulty budget profiles, and player-facing objective screen text.
limits: Distances to visible blue linework are geometric review signals only. These modern geographic controls do not define ancient shorelines, land availability, drainage, or safe terrain.
Corridor lines are straight proposals with declared widths; this audit does not certify intermediate paths or native pathfinding.
Budget results are static design arithmetic, not gathered-resource or in-game testing.

mainIdentities.notes: The main objective predicates use area-state, entity-state, and resource-transaction only. No derived-token requirement or assistant return/current-residence check is present. The world contract separately marks original identities finite and irreplaceable.

o1.visitRequirement: area-state visited-and-passable for the three ordinary work-court zones
o1.registration: six specific original helper IDs and three specific original note IDs collected
o1.assessment: The three work courts and all destinations are explicitly disclosed.

o2.helperRequirement: o2/req-1: all six original helpers arrive, two each at destination-2 western, destination-3 northern, and destination-5 southern courts.
o2.fundingRequirement: o2/req-2 resource-transaction, once and atomic: 360 food, 240 wood, 60 stone total.
o2.assessment: Every helper has one assigned receiving zone; a single full allocation at one court does not satisfy the three separate shares.

o3.noteRequirement: o3/req-1: note 1 arrives at destination-2 west, note 2 at destination-3 north, note 3 at destination-5 south.
o3.assessment: Three distinct original note IDs have separate destinations. Prior helper receptions remain historical receipts; the objective text explicitly says they do not imply current residence. No current-presence or return requirement is present.

survivalContract.helperGroup: all 6 original helper identities required alive or already safe
survivalContract.noteGroup: all 3 original note identities required alive or already safe
survivalContract.source: worldContract.survivorGroups minimumAliveOrAlreadySafe values are 6 and 3, respectively.
survivalContract.assessment: This checks survival/identity preservation, not a present-day location at earlier work courts.

staticSkipAllOptionalSolvency.assessment: All three static resource profiles balance exactly at the declared post-reward bank. This is arithmetic verification only; no gameplay or gathering was tested.

projection.result: All six stored hub centers exactly match tile_point(bbox, hub.lonLat, 400) at stored two-decimal precision.

hubs.note: Hub 6 matches the corrected coordinate supplied for this audit. Distance is to the nearest displayed modern line, not an ancient shore boundary.

zoneOverlapsForReview.assessment: Exact shared optional target disk; may be intended common southern-junction area.
Exact shared optional target disk at central yard; review whether the two recipients are intentionally co-located.

entityOverlapForReview.assessment: Distinct optional identities have the same starting point. They may be separately spawned/task-specific, but the shared coordinate is worth confirming.

corridors.assessment: No displayed blue segment intersects a declared full-width corridor in the current schematic geometry. Southern corridors are closest, with 22.19 tiles minimum edge-to-line gap under this calculation. This does not certify ancient land or actual pathfinding.

visibleWaterControls.representation: Six blue polylines are drawn. mapPlan lists modern regional shoreline and river-centerline sources; SVG paths are not individually tagged by source type.
visibleWaterControls.mapPlanInterpretation: Modern regional shoreline control, not ancient harbor geometry; modern river controls where available. Minor channels and ancient courses need separate evidence.
visibleWaterControls.note: The SVG depicts modern control linework against an otherwise uniform tile square. It supplies no terrain raster, flood/shore polygon, elevation, or ancient bank mask. A route staying on one side of visible lines is a limited geometric observation, not a land-side certificate.

notes: Six hub circles, six dashed land corridors, and six blue modern control segments are visible; no optional entities or zones are shown.
Legend states the routes are proposals, not surveyed paths or a terrain raster, and that ancient shore/elevation are not inferred.
No boat route is actually drawn despite the generic cyan boat-passage legend entry.

mainPlayerText.o2.en: Deliver the assigned pair of original helpers to each work court. Allocate exactly 120 food, 80 wood and 20 stone to each court once: 360 food, 240 wood and 60 stone total.
mainPlayerText.o2.es-ES: Entrega la pareja asignada de ayudantes originales a cada patio. Asigna una vez exactamente 120 de alimento, 80 de madera y 20 de piedra a cada patio: 360 de alimento, 240 de madera y 60 de piedra en total.
mainPlayerText.o3.en: Deliver the first original supply note west, the second north and the third south. Keep all six original helpers and all three notes intact; prior work-court receptions remain recorded without requiring current residence.
mainPlayerText.o3.es-ES: Entrega la primera nota original al oeste, la segunda al norte y la tercera al sur. Conserva intactos los seis ayudantes originales y las tres notas; las acogidas anteriores siguen registradas sin exigir permanencia actual.

textReview.formatting: No comma-number spacing defect was found in the current main goal strings; resource quantities are separated and per-court versus total allocations are explicit.
textReview.internalQaText: QA metadata includes compact shorthand `Exactly120F80W20S`; this is internal QA text rather than a player caption, so it is not logged as UI leakage.

architectFollowUp.author: gpt-6
architectFollowUp.decision: Guide origin is independently offset[-10,-6], avoiding exact overlap with the first aid crate. Two shared receiving circles intentionally share a work court but have disjoint original identities and independent health/payment/arrival ledgers. Native footprints still pending.
architectFollowUp.pacing: No enemies or main deadline; lower worker count may mainly increase waiting. Static solvency does not establish meaningful difficulty. Require actual playtime, worker-use, optional completion and idle-time measurements before promotion.
